coverage_assessment: Open-web research is persisted in 14 English-, French- and Arabic-language queries and 133 source cards covering all January weekly windows, regional and sector leads, and December/February boundaries. These operational counts do not demonstrate completeness or absence. Ten tentative candidates include partial Gafsa gathering evidence, January night actions with contested protest/looting framing, and a distinct Sousse Jan20 stand and march with explicit state-directed demands but no crowd estimate. Local attendance, demands, episode boundaries and response remain unresolved for several records; some sources were blocked or incomplete, and regional/sector coverage is uneven. Search query strings and aligned result headers/refs are saved, but ephemeral raw-return store key names were not persisted and cannot be verified after context compaction. The S010 timed-out HTTPS request lacks a saved numeric process exit code/session ID. No queries were rerun; the official baseline gate remains unresolved.
